description: Source code for a C# language generator used in Playwright's code generation, supporting different modes (library, MSTest, NUnit). It defines classes and functions to generate C# code snippets for browser automation tasks.

classes.name: CSharpLanguageGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating C# code snippets for browser automation, supporting different modes and actions.

classes.name: CSharpFormatter
classes.description: Helper class for formatting generated C# code with proper indentation and line management.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates C# code for a specific browser automation action based on context.

methods.name: _generateActionInner
methods.description: Internal method that creates code snippets for actions, handling dialogs, downloads, popups, and navigation.

methods.name: _formatPageAlias
methods.description: Formats page alias based on mode and context.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates specific C# method calls for actions like click, fill, navigate, etc.

methods.name: _asLocator
methods.description: Converts a selector into a C# locator string.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the header code for C# test or standalone scripts.

methods.name: generateStandaloneHeader
methods.description: Creates header code for standalone C# scripts.

methods.name: generateTestRunnerHeader
methods.description: Creates header code for C# test runner scripts (NUnit or MSTest).

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates footer code, including storage state saving.
